Pfim 0.11.4 by Nick Babcock

Source revision: 0a00d8152ca4dc0e0a5821c6b8fd5261fca1e84d
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Pfim/0.11.4

Pfim is distributed under the accompanying MIT license. The application uses
its managed DDS block-compression decoder to show roster pictures directly.
Pfim.dll targets .NET Standard 2.0 and has no additional package dependencies.
